The '''Vapor Scream''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] known for watered-down drinks and catered to [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] and [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] crews. A group of spacers were hired by [[F'ej D'aw]] in the Vapor Scream to transport his boss, [[Nawnam]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] off-[[Planet/Legends|world]].<ref name="HL">{{WEGCite|book=Instant Adventures|story=Heavy Lifting}}</ref>
